result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there is one clear text-rendering/layout problem in the restaurant details section.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line is visibly overlapping or duplicated: the delivery-time text collides with the delivery/category text, making the line difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata layout and spacing, ensuring the delivery time, delivery fee, separator, and cuisine label are rendered once in a single properly aligned row or wrap cleanly onto separate lines.
